summary: May 4: Dow -0.98%, Nasdaq/S&P 500 down ~0.5%. UAE intercepted Iranian missiles; WTI crude +4% above $106, Brent +5% above $114. VIX spiked. PLTR rising pre-earnings, STX surged on blowout earnings, GME bid $125/sh for eBay driving EBAY +10%.
